arguments.value: Henry Franklin Floyd is a United States Circuit Judge on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit, taking senior status in 2021. Born in Brevard, North Carolina, in 1947, he earned his B.A. from Wofford College in 1970 and his J.D. from the University of South Carolina School of Law in 1973. Floyd began his legal career in private practice in Pickens, South Carolina, while also serving as a state representative from 1972 to 1978 and as county attorney for Pickens County from 1986 to 1992. He later served as a judge on the South Carolina Circuit Court for the Thirteenth Judicial Circuit from 1992 to 2003 before being appointed to the federal bench as a U.S. District Judge for the District of South Carolina in 2003. In 2011, he was confirmed to the Fourth Circuit, where he has served since.
